subject: Reseller evidence Q&A and onboarding plan for AWS Private Offer activation
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Reseller evidence Q&A and onboarding plan for AWS Private Offer activation

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for agreeing to co-sell with us on the AWS Private Offer for the Acme pilot. To keep the activation on track, please can you provide the items below so we can complete the CPPO setup and entitlement mapping: 

- Legal entity name and registered address (for marketplace mapping)
- AWS Seller ID (12-digit) and Marketplace account email
- SOC 2 report or attestation document (if not ready, ETA on completion)
- Signed reseller addendum (I attached the draft PPO activation template)
- Billing remit-to entity and AP contact (PO/email)
- CSV with SKU-to-customer mappings for the initial launch (sample attachment format attached)

I attached a draft onboarding checklist and the PPO activation template to speed reviews. Can you confirm target dates for SOC2 and the signed agreement? Our ideal go-live window is the week of 2026-06-07 if we can close documents this week.

If any item will take longer, call out which one and we can propose an interim routing for invoices. Ben — tagging you for pricing/entitlement alignment. Kimberly — please review billing prerequisites below.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-reseller-onboarding-checklist.pdf (pdf, 85KB); ppo-activation-template.docx (docx, 42KB)

From: Sarah Lim <sarah@cloudresell.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudresell.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reseller evidence Q&A and onboarding plan for AWS Private Offer activation

Hi Jordan —

Appreciate the checklist. Quick updates: 

- Legal entity: CloudResell, Inc.; address attached in W9.
- AWS Seller ID: 987654321012
- SOC 2: in final review with auditor, expecting attestation by 2026-06-02
- We can sign the reseller addendum via DocuSign — please send the envelope
- Billing/AP: procurement@cloudresell.com (CC'd) and remit-to is CloudResell, Inc. / 102 Commerce Way, Seattle, WA
- SKU mapping: attached sample CSV (cloudresell-seller-profile.csv) — we'll fill actual mapping by EOD Fri if that works

Two quick Qs from our side: 
1) Do you require a certified SOC2 report (Type II) for initial go-live, or will a signed SOC2 engagement letter + expected completion date suffice?
2) Any objections to a 60-day net term for initial pilot invoices?

I'll attach the W9 and the seller profile CSV now. If you want to jump on a quick call to walk through the CSV layout, happy to do 30 mins tomorrow.

Best,
Sarah Lim
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | CloudResell, Inc.
sarah@cloudresell.com | +1 (206) 555-0345

Attachments: cloudresell-seller-profile.csv (csv, 6KB); company_w9.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Lim <sarah@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reseller evidence Q&A and onboarding plan for AWS Private Offer activation

Appreciate the quick responses, Sarah. A couple of notes from pricing/entitlement: 

- We'll need the SKU mapping to ensure entitlements align to the PPO product codes. If CloudResell can provide the mapping by Friday we can lock entitlements for the Acme pilot.
- 60-day net terms: acceptable for the pilot but note that finance will require an entity verification before PO acceptance. Kimberly — can you confirm what docs we need to accept 60-day terms?

Jordan — suggest we set an internal checkpoint on Friday to confirm the mapping is in the right format and that legal has the addendum out for signature.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Lim <sarah@cloudresell.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reseller evidence Q&A and onboarding plan for AWS Private Offer activation

Hi all —

Finance/Billing checklist for accepting 60-day net on the pilot: 

- Current W9 (received, thanks)
- Legal entity verification (DUNS or Articles of Incorporation) — if you can share DUNS# that speeds this up
- Signed reseller addendum via DocuSign (request Jordan to send)
- Contact name + email for invoice escalations (procurement@cloudresell.com okay but we prefer a named contact too)

I attached a billing-entity-mapping-template.xlsx for your use. For the initial go-live we can accept provisional entitlements and route invoices to CloudResell with 'net-60 pilot' noted, provided the verification items above are completed within the next two weeks.

Kimberly Park
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: billing-entity-mapping-template.xlsx (xlsx, 18KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reseller evidence Q&A and onboarding plan for AWS Private Offer activation

Sarah — thanks for the fast turnaround and for the attachments. Quick summary / mutual action plan so we have the same dates: 

- Today: Redwood sends DocuSign envelope for reseller addendum (Jordan) — link: https://www.docusign.net/envelope/EXAMPLE-ENVELOPE-ID
- By EOD Fri (2026-05-22): CloudResell to provide completed SKU mapping CSV (you indicated EOD Fri)
- By 2026-06-02: SOC2 attestation expected (Sarah ETA)
- By 2026-06-04: Finance verifies entity details once we receive DUNS or Articles (CloudResell)
- Target go-live window: week of 2026-06-07 for pilot activation (dependent on completed items above)

If any of the above slips, call it out and we'll propose a temporary routing to allow the Acme pilot to start (e.g., route invoices to Redwood with reimbursement to CloudResell).

I'll send the DocuSign now. If you want to quick-review the SKU CSV format before Friday, Ben or I can hop on a 30-minute call tomorrow.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
